botbase.title: BotBase
botbase.description: Browse the Cloudflare Bots and Agents Directory, submit new bots, and track or update your submissions.
botbase.form.intro: Submit an application to add a verified bot or a signed agent to the <0>Cloudflare Bots and Agents Directory</0>.
botbase.form.bot_kind.verified_bot_descr: An automated bot that identifies itself and follows the rules operators set.
botbase.form.bot_kind.signed_agent_descr: An AI agent that acts on behalf of a user and cryptographically signs its requests.
botbase.form.operator_name_description: Select an operator or enter a new operator name.
botbase.form.documentation_url_descripti: A publicly accessible page describing your bot.
botbase.form.access.direct_description: A bot run by a single operator from its own infrastructure.
botbase.form.access.intermediary_descrip: A platform that runs automated traffic on behalf of many operators.
botbase.form.categories_description: Select every behavior this bot performs. A bot can have more than one classification.
botbase.form.content_use_tooltip: Declare the highest level of content use this bot needs.
botbase.form.content_use.immediate_descr: Content is used to answer the current request only.
botbase.form.content_use.reference_descr: Content is cited or linked back to the source.
botbase.form.content_use.full_descriptio: Content may be retained and reused, including for training.
botbase.form.verification.rdns_descripti: Verify via a reverse-DNS domain suffix.
botbase.form.verification.rdns_round_tri: The domain resolves back to the source IP (forward-confirmed). Leave on unless your reverse DNS is not forward-confirmed.
botbase.form.verification.ip_list_descri: Verify via a published list of IPs.
botbase.form.verification.web_bot_auth_d: Verify via a signed HTTP message.
botbase.form.success: Your submission was received and is pending review.
botbase.form.error: Something went wrong submitting your bot. Please try again.
botbase.form.validation.url: Enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.
botbase.form.validation.https: Enter a valid URL starting with https://.
botbase.form.validation.rdns: Enter a valid domain suffix, e.g. .example.com.
botbase.form.validation.ip_list: Enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://.
